profile.headline: Embedded Software & Hardware Development Engineer
profile.summary:
My top qualifications as I consider myself are in being a critical thinker and self starter. I approach each new situation with enthusiasm and thorough analysis, create an action plan and then implement and communicate it. I enjoy working with others both in learning from them and leading them in successful project completion. I have a broad background in hardware and software development  which allowed me to excel as Director of Hardware systems

Specialties: Linux Embedded Software Development, FPGA based system design, digital logic board design, microprocessor based board design, project management embedded software

positions.title: Hardware Software Engineer
positions.description: C development and debug for battery chargers using an 8051 type processor. KiCad schematic for hardware design. Support for multiple Li-on battery and charger products. Analysis and resolution of hardware/software design and field issues. Particularly ESD, communications and BMS configuration.  Transfer of development environment to open source environment SDCC. Adding SMBus stack protocol decode

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: C development for vehicular beacon in a BLE mesh network using an STM32F413, STM32CubeIDE, Fork GIT and JIRA. Created new functionality and debugged existing.  Areas worked included I2C reworked and error recovery. Remapping data parameters from CAN to cloud interface based on machine type. Designed and implemented eMMC based data circular buffer logging facility including real time reads to cloud and writes from equipment and POR scanning.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Devices · Embedded Software · Embedded Software Programming

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: C++ and C development on new product battery based power supply 3300R. Created new functionality and debugged existing. Using windows environment with ADO, git, STM32 IAR, CANOPEN, PCAN, Sourcetree, Python, Scrum, CI/CD, Agile, Sprint, JAMA, Google Test, Eclipse, Renesas, IEC UL 67030. Worked on Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and applications and device driver level for battery management, requirements, safety and user interface. Some particular areas included SoH model interface system faults, bootloader,
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · Embedded Software · C++

positions.title: Hardware and Software Developer
positions.description:
Wrist medical device. Design and implementation for new and debug of existing features. STM32 processor with BLE
connected to local and remote Maxim and other vendor PPG, ECG, GSR, IMU and Temp sensors. Bare metal
STM32CubeIDE C code driver, sleep, GPIO, development. Altium Board PCB via in pad, IPC, annular ring, Gerbers.
Hardware updates for hot swap remote ECG. TVS, external facing STM32 line driver data and power interface

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
ucLinux driver debug and development for implementation of new radio module. Development system on Linux Virtual Box
Ubuntu. Device tree and overlay validation. Worked to resolve UART communication issue between radio and user interface modules

positions.title: Hardware Development Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer for hardware and embedded C software for Federal US government military infrared sensor array based products. CodeComposer for TI MSP430 C code debug. Orcad schematic design for MSP Microcontrollers, I2C and SPI based sensors, micro OLED displays, video encoder, USB, GPS and power rails. Cadence layout and routing. FPGA based RTL, Xilinx Vitis & Vivado for Microblaze processor and video processing.

positions.title: Head of Hardware Systems
positions.description: Director of hardware and embedded systems design for premier wall mountable energy storage device.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, United States
positions.description: Integrating I2C sensors with Qualcom Based Quectel Cell Phone modem for real time environmental monitoring. M2M network communications using TCP-IP, AT Modem, LTE, GSM, CAT-M and NB-IoT technologies for small size, low power cargo monitoring applications.

positions.title: VHDL Design Certification Engineer
positions.description: Creation of traceability matrix in DOORS between high level requirements,  Matlab/Simulink models and VHDL code in accordance with DO-254 standards. Review of models to ensure alignment with the high level requirements.  Review of VHDL code to ensure proper implementation of the models. Use of Synergy configuration system and Rational Change for tracking and reporting. Review and audit of the development processes in preparation for Boeing 777 aerospace flight readiness.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Full software development cycle responsibilities for ARRIS/PACE new and legacy TV set top box (STB) product sets. Code development, test, release and factory support for manufacturing test platform and customer deliverables. Using C/C++ and CVS repository tools in Linux Fedora. Highlights include:

positions.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
positions.description:
Full software development cycle responsibilities for ARRIS/PACE new set top box line. 

Code development, test, release and factory support for manufacturing test platform. Both client and gateway boxes. Using C/C++ and CVS repository tools. This new line has made it into volume production. Highlights include:
- User menu system updates,
- Low level Broadcom CPU pin multiplier correction for BlueTooth
- Completed interface for Realtek Audio Codec Chip

positions.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
positions.description:
Full product lifecycle responsibilities for GTS’s Genius Battery Family. Smart batteries with on board Atmel micro controller. Responsibilities include embedded software and hardware design, test, release, documentation and support.

Completed to customer delivery and support GTS Genius Embedded C software system including battery State of Health , I2C communications, charging and protection system.

Full project responsibility for new unique battery 1 wire communications protocol.

Corrected GTS Chargers software to support Genius batteries.

Assisted with batteries hardware design and verification including protection, charge/discharge and communications.

positions.title: Digital Project Leader
positions.description:
Full product lifecycle responsibilities for the Siemens MI PET products including technical design and project management. Responsibilities include FPGA design, circuit doard design, test, verification, documentation and inter departmental communications

Specific tasks included helped localize an issue with data processing on a Fibre Channel link implemented using Xilinx Virtex 2 Pro Rocket IO and SFF SLC optical connections.

Created software tools to analyze PET sinogram file header data to identify the issue.

positions.title: Lead Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Full hardware project responsibilities for security access controllers utilizing Xilinx FPGA MicroBlaze soft processor.  Specific design responsibilities included successful implementation of  NAND interface utilizing VHDL and Modelsim. Specification development Timing closure.

ucLinux based software development. Cross compile and build/make  tool chain on Linux PC

Research, conception, design, develop, implementation, test, support.

Upgraded system to reduce cost by 50% and increase performance by ten times with NAND Flash, 2nd Ethernet port and doubled SDRAM. 

Tasks included coordination with in house and external teams for test, procurement, manufacturing and certification. 

Hardware logic and board schematic designs, embedded C and assembly code design, reviews, simulation, test, quality, certifications, parts analysis, layout design specification and implementation, and documentation. 

Raised the level of department technical knowledge by coordinated initial training of members in Xilinx FPGA development of soft core processors. 

Architectural evaluation of new security platform for update to code base.

positions.title: Lead Hardware Engineer
positions.description: Altera FPGA design, build and communications debug for cell phone development.

positions.title: Project Manager, Hardware Engineer, Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Project manager for the flagship "Resolve" product which grossed $10M.  
•	Responsibilities included communications, scheduling, budgeting, technical coordination, and quality control. 
•	Hardware engineering responsibilities in full digital design for logic systems for control panels, real time video processors using Virtex Xilinx FPGA’s, VHDL, Verilog
•	Designed power supply and analog and digital drive system for Vacuum Fluorescents display for updated user control panels. Evaluated TFT LCD drive and interface systems for use in user control panels.
- Training wiht MatLab and Simulink and short term development experience
- micro controllers, microprocessor and PCIX interface.  
- Mentor Leonardo & Synthesis, Xilinx tools for FPGA implementation and time closure. 
 - Orcad and Mentor Capture for board design. Layout. ICX for Signal Integrity for LVDS 200 MHz inter FPA communications.
•	Design, Simulate, Test, PCB, Implement. 
•	Embedded software engineering projects using C/C++ and assembly included user session data translator, user interface, machine control and communications.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
design engineer and  support for a hand held digital video multi
meter.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Hardware Engineer, System Support
positions.description: Design engineer and system support engineer for the Federal US government NASA Space Shuttle Launch System. Lead assembly language programmer on embedded control system for printers. Received Divisional Award for role in getting new product to market overcoming barriers between multiple divisions and disciplines. Software then hardware design engineer for design and implementation of semi-conductor manufacturing systems. Responsible for creative and engineering effort that provided local control bypass overrides

patents.title: Instrument responsive to acceleration forces
patents.description: The invention provides an instrument responsive to acceleration forces. In the preferred embodiment, a body of magnetic material is positioned in a cavity such that it moves to a central position in response to a magnetic field and moves along a preselected path in response to acceleration forces. Means is included permitting the position of the body of magnetic material to be determined. The position of the body of magnetic material relative to the structure of the instrument is an indication of the acceleration force applied to the instrument.

patents.title: Instrument producing electrical signals in response to acceleration forces
patents.description: This invention provides an instrument responsive to acceleration forces. In the preferred embodiment, a body of magnetic material is positioned in a cavity such that it moves to a central position in response to a magnetic field and moves along a preselected path in response to acceleration forces. Means is included permitting the position of the body of magnetic material to be determined. The position of the body of magnetic material relative to the structure of the instrument is an indication of the magnitude of the acceleration force applied to the instrument.
